purpose: Explain the dominant BCE/BVE replacement cycle structurally before allowing any larger construction search.

analysis_scope.included_occurrences: only pair outcomes whose first R33 rule is BCE or accepted BVE

debt_hypergraph.BCE_requirement: for each currently blocked (C,l), direct additive invalidation requires an added clause containing -l whose resolvent with C is non-tautological
debt_hypergraph.BVE_requirement: for each currently accepted BVE pivot x, direct additive invalidation must at minimum touch x or -x
debt_hypergraph.candidate_incidence_universe: all non-duplicate, non-tautological binary clauses over variables present in the post-DP state
debt_hypergraph.coverage_question: can all already-existing necessary BCE+BVE incidence debts be paid by one binary clause, by two binary clauses, or not by any pair

conditional_next_gate.reason: If static necessary debts themselves exceed pair capacity, source-realizability of that minimum debt is next. If pair capacity already pays all static debts, the observed pairwise collapse must instead be explained by insufficiency/dynamic regeneration of escape doors.

forbidden_claims: post-DP cover is reachable from a valid source
BCE/BVE dominance generalizes beyond the frozen replay
